title: Period
description: The interval span that repeats or frames a tuning system.

title.label: Title
title.heading: Period
title.body: A period is the interval after which a tuning pattern repeats or is treated as equivalent. The octave is the most familiar period, but xenharmonic systems can use non-octave periods too.

lab.label: Lab
lab.prompt: The Period lab will go here.

qa.label: Q&A
qa.question: What role does a period play in a tuning?

choices.text: It defines the repeating or equivalence span of the system.
It always forces the system to use twelve notes.

items.title: Compare periods
items.body: Write one difference between an octave period and a non-octave period.

items.title: Name a repeat span
items.body: Choose a ratio, such as 2/1 or 3/1, and describe what repeats at that span.
